purpose: Determine whether the V31 residual conditional mean contains reproducible nonlinear information in the full oriented local observable/backbone patch that was discarded by the V32 mean/std summaries, before changing or retraining the generative residual model.

target_and_scales.target: nonoverlapping block mean of physical y residual truth minus the frozen V14 corrected backbone plus predicted residual DC

scalar: central exact individual-galaxy population velocity dispersion pooled from native unbiased sig_v
radius from observer divided by cube half-width
features.oriented_single_scale: scalar plus the lexicographically ordered periodic 3x3x3 patches at offsets (-1,0,1)^3 of log1p count, mean velocity, exact pooled sig_v, and backbone mean; no mean/std compression and no rotation-invariant sorting
features.oriented_multiscale: oriented_single_scale plus the same four ordered 3x3x3 patches on the factor-2 coarser grid, mapped to each current cell by its containing parent block

fixed_training_rows.selection: without-replacement NumPy PCG64 permutation from the exact V32 train-row population after its factor-4 parity selection or factor-8 all-row selection
fixed_training_rows.source_balance: exactly equal rows from TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift; concatenate in that order
fixed_training_rows.validation: all rows of every frozen validation cube; streamed by cube and never used for fitting or early stopping

fixed_nonlinear_learner.hardware: Lageunha CPU; no GPU is needed for this prerequisite audit

frozen_linear_reference.rule: read byte-frozen per-domain validation RMSE only; do not refit or alter the V33 reference

predeclared_interpretation.nonlinear_scalar_supported: nonlinear_scalar/V33_linear_base validation RMSE <=0.98 in all three domains at either common factor
predeclared_interpretation.oriented_patch_supported: nonlinear_oriented_single_scale/nonlinear_scalar validation RMSE <=0.98 in all three domains at either common factor
predeclared_interpretation.multiscale_increment_supported: nonlinear_oriented_multiscale/nonlinear_oriented_single_scale validation RMSE <=0.99 in all three domains at either common factor
predeclared_interpretation.material_full_model_gain: nonlinear_oriented_multiscale/V33_linear_base validation RMSE <=0.95 in all three domains at either common factor
predeclared_interpretation.next_if_oriented_patch_supported: freeze a matched local conditional-mean/backbone ablation and inject learned oriented multiscale context into the later conditional residual likelihood
predeclared_interpretation.next_if_only_scalar_supported: replace scalar binned conditioning by a nonlinear scalar conditional mean before changing the spatial likelihood
predeclared_interpretation.next_if_neither_supported: treat the remaining failure as conditional spatial covariance/copula rather than predictable local mean; freeze a conditional multiscale residual-spectrum and phase-coupling audit

firewall.development_truth_role: fit on train only and evaluate validation only after this committed freeze
